verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a web analytics product, since alternatives in this category offer it, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a Google-hosted service, accessed through APIs, the Measurement Protocol and BigQuery export. Exporting raw data to BigQuery or installing the MCP server from GitHub does not mean running the core analytics product on your own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
